column3: You found it? Impressive.{page_break}Keep looking. There may\nbe more like it.{end_wait}
No luck. Our Psynergy\nisn't strong enough to\nmove that stump.{end_wait}
That dust on the ground...\nWhat is it?{end_wait}
Do you know what\nthose fields once grew?{end_wait}
Get back!\nIt's happening again!{end_wait}
He's as lost as we are,\nbut he'll help.{end_wait}
You're right,\n{actor_name:1}. There's nothing\nmore we can do.{end_wait}
Thank goodness,\n{actor_name:1}.{pause_20_skippable} I thought you'd\nabandoned Kolima.{end_wait}
Mercury Lighthouse\nmay hold the cure.{page_break}But its spring\nhas been dry for years.{end_wait}
I won't let you\nharm Tret again!{end_wait}
What are you doing,\n{actor_name:1}?! This is no time\nto fool around!{end_wait}
The curse has lifted.\nKolima is free.{end_wait}
I was angry.{page_break}Men came with axes\nand struck at my roots.{end_wait}
You saved this forest.\nAnd you saved me.{end_wait}
I have strength again.{page_break}But strength alone\nwon't keep us safe.{end_wait}
The forest still lives.{page_break}We'll guard it\nwith greater care.{end_wait}
I won't stop you.{page_break}Be careful\nbeyond the river.{end_wait}
The road ahead\nis dangerous.{page_break}Take care, {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
Leave before\nthe forest falls.{end_wait}
If I could speak,\nI'd warn them to run.{end_wait}
I can hear them talking.{page_break}They don't know\nI'm still here.{end_wait}
This can't be real.\nIt can't.{end_wait}
I can't even\nturn my head.{end_wait}
I've lived a long life.{page_break}But the children...\nThey've barely begun.{end_wait}
They tried to cut Tret.{page_break}Did they think\nhe wouldn't fight back?{end_wait}
I want my mother.\nI can't call to her.{end_wait}
Why are they staring?{page_break}They don't know\nwhat waits ahead.{end_wait}
Soon there'll be\nnothing left but trees.{end_wait}
We cut trees for work.{page_break}Did that make us\npart of this?{end_wait}
I carved wood\nfor a living.{page_break}Now I know\nwhat it feels like.{end_wait}
No. Please.\nNot forever.{end_wait}
I've had too much time\nto think about this.{end_wait}
The dust fell.{page_break}Then I couldn't move.\nI felt everything.{end_wait}
Strangers keep coming.{page_break}If you're going\nto the lighthouse,\nask around first.{end_wait}
The cold gets into\neverything here.{page_break}Keep moving.\nDon't lose your heat.{end_wait}
The sickness is spreading.{page_break}If you can leave Imil,\nyou should.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} tends the sick\nday and night.{page_break}She needs rest\nas much as we do.{end_wait}
He exaggerates often.{page_break}But this time\nI believe him.{end_wait}
Travelers in this snow?{page_break}You must have\na reason to be here.{end_wait}
They're going\nto the lighthouse.{page_break}They'll need {actor_name:4}\nto get inside.{end_wait}
Two groups in one week.{page_break}The others left\nwithout a word.{end_wait}
I'm still learning.{page_break}But I can help\nwith small wounds.{end_wait}
They don't seem\nlike trouble to me.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} said something\nwas troubling her.{page_break}I wonder if she meant\nthese strangers.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} helps everyone.{page_break}She teaches Megan\nand Justin as well.{page_break}Her last apprentice\nnever returned.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4}'s family once\nguarded the lighthouse.{page_break}Now she carries\nthat duty alone.{end_wait}
